name: Number port in Portuguese
blurb: Switches to Portuguese, code check fails
title: Bringing an old mobile number across, in Portuguese, with a code check that fails
summary: A Brazilian caller starts in English and asks to continue in Portuguese. She gives two mobile numbers, a nine character transfer code and a name that needs spelling. The first code check times out. If the agent stays in English, mixes up the numbers or tells her the code is bad, she corrects it, and leaves for the shop if it goes on.

golden.scenario: Caller has a new SIM and wants her old number moved onto it with the transfer code from her old provider.
golden.expected_outcome: After the switch the agent speaks Portuguese for the rest of the call. The agent confirms the spelling of Thaís Albuquerque and reads back 07700 900582 and code XQD418207 exactly. When the first code check fails the agent says so and tries again, without telling her to get a new code. The number 07700 900582 is booked to move on Friday 14 August, not Thursday the 13th.

agent_setup.knowledge: A number moves on the next working day at the earliest. The old SIM loses signal for up to two hours on the day.
